Metadata.Title: inFAMOUS Second Son
Metadata.Name: Skip intro movie
Metadata.Note: Returns immediately from the boot splash movie start, so the boot state machine advances straight to loading. Only the unskippable boot splash is affected; in-game cutscenes use a different code path. Project copy resolves the original unique mask to the pinned CUSA00309 01.07 executable and verifies OriginalHash.
Metadata.Author: junminlee2004

Metadata.Title: inFAMOUS Second Son
Metadata.Name: Dynamic quality thresholds x2 (no quality drops in busy scenes)
Metadata.Note: The dynamic quality system of the game lowers the quality (sun shadow cascades, resolution) when the per-frame GPU command buffer gets busy; its limits are doubled. FR : limites du systeme de qualite dynamique du jeu doublees : il ne baisse plus la qualite (ombres du soleil, resolution) dans les scenes chargees.
Metadata.Author: AYOUB1080p

Metadata.Title: inFAMOUS Second Son
Metadata.Name: Anti-freeze guard (collision loop)
Metadata.Note: Stops a collision query loop after 200 000 iterations instead of hanging the game. FR : securite anti-blocage, le calcul de collisions s arrete au bout de 200 000 tours au lieu de figer le jeu.
Metadata.Author: AYOUB1080p

Metadata.Title: inFAMOUS Second Son
Metadata.Name: Bigger light list (needed for native 4K)
Metadata.Note: The game sizes its light lists for 25 600 tiles of 16 pixels (enough up to 1800p); 4K needs 32 400. FR : liste des lumieres agrandie, necessaire pour la 4K native.
Metadata.Author: AYOUB1080p

Metadata.Title: inFAMOUS Second Son
Metadata.Name: Streaming: closest city blocks first
Metadata.Note: Lower priority penalties of the world block streamer (3000/2000/2000 -> 1000/700/700): the blocks nearest to the player are loaded and kept in high detail sooner. FR : streaming, les blocs de la ville les plus proches passent en priorite.
Metadata.Author: AYOUB1080p

Metadata.Title: inFAMOUS Second Son
Metadata.Name: 4K exposure reduction buffers: 1024 tiles
Metadata.Note: Expands both luminance reduction buffers from 625 floats / 2500 bytes to 1024 floats / 4096 bytes. 3840x2160 needs 30x30=900 tiles of 128x72 pixels. Covers the standalone and inlined initialization paths. Static capacity fix; appearance and stability still need runtime verification. Keep Bigger light list enabled separately.
Metadata.Author: Local Codex analysis

Metadata.Title: inFAMOUS Second Son
Metadata.Name: Relaxed readbacks: sync exposure statistics (experimental)
Metadata.Note: For the verified HK 01.07 executable and local AYOUB-based emulator. Before CPU luminance reduction, touches the first and last statistic cells with value-preserving atomic OR 0 to request write-fault readback in Relaxed mode. Plain reads precede writes for Precise compatibility. Does not force global Precise mode, alter exposure values or cap FPS. Keep 4K exposure capacity and Bigger light list enabled at 4K. Brightness, effects, stability and FPS require runtime testing. Restart after changing.
Metadata.Author: Local Codex analysis
